metadata.title: Tesla-SpaceX merger talks advance, but China exposure tests Musk's vertical integration ambitions

content.text:
As Tesla and SpaceX move from conceptual discussions toward formal merger negotiations, the prospect of what could become the largest corporate merger in history is lending further momentum to Elon Musk's ambitions to consolidate his sprawling technology...
The article requires paid subscription.
